You may speak for as long as you wish.
What are the steps involved when people have to do laundry?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: First, gather the dirty clothes and separate the whites from the colors. Check the pockets and the care labels, then put a load in the washing machine without packing it too full. Add detergent, choose the right cycle and temperature, and start it. When it’s finished, hang the clothes up or put them in the dryer, depending on the labels. Once they’re dry, fold them or put them on hangers and put them away.
